const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,difflib
p='.ai/task/batch-c9ca70f29bc203b33050-surface-001/SURFACE-SCREEN-ENVELOPE-full-001.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
for i,e in enumerate(d['payload']['entries'][:2]):
 sa=[m for m in re.finditer(r'<\?.*?\?>',e['source'],re.S)]; ta=[m for m in re.finditer(r'<\?.*?\?>',e['target'],re.S)]
 print('ENTRY',i,'source',len(sa),'target',len(ta))
 s=[m.group() for m in sa];t=[m.group() for m in ta]
 for op,x,y,u,v in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,s,t,autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
  if op=='equal': continue
  print(op,'source',[(m.group(),e['source'][max(0,m.start()-35):min(len(e['source']),m.end()+35)].replace('\n','\\n')) for m in sa[x:y]])
  print(op,'target',[(m.group(),e['target'][max(0,m.start()-35):min(len(e['target']),m.end()+35)].replace('\n','\\n')) for m in ta[u:v]])
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","max_output_tokens":5500,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"May I locate the exact placeholder differences within the specified frozen entries?"});text(r.output);
